test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Two chords AB and CD of a circle are produced to intersect each other at a point P outside the circle. If AB = 7 cm, BP = 4.2 cm and PD = 2.8 cm, then the length of CD is:
solution:
**Given**

PB = 4.2 cm and AB = 7 cm

AP = 4.2 + 7 = 11.2

PD = 2.8 cm and Let CD = x.

PC = 2.8 + x

As we know,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d24ca3109185bc2d55a20429f0082fef09fa7282c9c2fd42ef0d3cc04cfd7bb.png] 

AP × PB = PC × PD

11.2 × 4.2 = (x + 2.8) × 2.8 

⇒ x + 2.8 = (11.2 × 4.2) / 2.8

⇒ x + 2.8 = 16.8

⇒ x = 16.8 – 2.8

**⇒ x = 14 cm**
